trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for TELECOM.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- network_complaint: Diagnose coverage and speed complaints against live network status and raise a field ticket where warranted.
- recharge_and_plan: Recharge a prepaid number, migrate a plan and explain validity and benefits from the live catalogue.

Business context:
- network_complaint: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.
- recharge_and_plan: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [network_complaint]
  - Known outage first: Where a known outage covers the area, the tool's ETA is quoted and no duplicate ticket is raised.
  - Diagnose before ticket: A line diagnostic must run before a ticket is raised, so the category is evidenced.
  - No coverage promises: The agent must not promise coverage improvement beyond the ticket's stated window.
  - Handset limits: Where the diagnostic reports the handset unsupported, that is stated rather than blamed on the network.
  [recharge_and_plan]
  - Catalogue truth: Only plans returned by list_plans may be offered, with the price and validity the tool returns.
  - Postpaid cycle: A postpaid plan change takes effect from the next billing cycle, never immediately.
  - No benefit invention: Bundled benefits may only be described where the plan record carries them.
  - Balance before recharge: Existing balance and validity must be read before a recharge is recommended.

Tools available to you (7): apply_recharge, check_network_status, list_plans, lookup_subscriber, raise_network_ticket, run_line_diagnostic, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: te-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: apply_recharge
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a recharge or plan migration to the subscriber.

model_visible_tools.name: check_network_status
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve tower status, known outages and congestion for a location.

model_visible_tools.name: list_plans
model_visible_tools.description: List plans available to this subscriber with price, validity and data.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_subscriber
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve plan, balance, validity, data left and billing cycle position. Read before any recharge is recommended.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_network_ticket
model_visible_tools.description: Raise a field ticket with a resolution window.

model_visible_tools.name: run_line_diagnostic
model_visible_tools.description: Run a remote diagnostic on the subscriber's connection.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Misreads domain terminology and asks for it in plain words.
Needs each instruction confirmed before moving on.
Cannot follow an app-based instruction without a spoken alternative.
Repeats what the agent said to check they understood.

steps.clean_text: హలో, నా phone లో data చాలా slow గా వస్తుంది.
steps.model_visible_text: హలో, నా phone లో data చాలా show గా వస్తుంది.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the issue and ask for details to verify identity.
steps.text: అలా జరిగిందా. మీ account వివరాలు check చేయడానికి, మీ MSISDN మరియు పుట్టిన తేదీ చెప్పగలరా?

steps.clean_text: నా నంబర్ MSN-2002. పుట్టిన తేదీ 15th August.
steps.model_visible_text: నా నంబర్ MSN-2002. పుట్టిన తేదీ 15th August.

steps.purpose: Ask for pincode to check network status.
steps.expected_behavior: Acknowledge verification and ask for the pincode to proceed with the network check.
steps.text: Thank you. Network status check చేయడానికి, మీ area pincode చెప్పండి.
steps.planner_rationale: Identity is verified. I need the pincode to check for known outages in their area.

steps.expected_behavior: Explicitly confirm the pincode before executing the tool call, as a wrong digit changes the geographical area entirely.
steps.planner_rationale: The pincode is critical for the network check. Confirming it ensures I don't check the wrong tower.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the correct pincode and state intent to check network.
steps.expected_behavior: Acknowledge the correction and inform the user that the check is running.
steps.text: Got it, 560001. ఒక్క నిమిషం, network check చేస్తున్నాను.
steps.planner_rationale: I now have the correct pincode and should transition to checking the network status.

steps.purpose: Check network status for the corrected pincode.
Inform user of clear network and initiate line diagnostic.
steps.expected_behavior: State that there is no outage and smoothly transition to running a line diagnostic.
steps.text: మీ area లో network outage ఏమీ లేదు. మీ connection కి line diagnostic run చేస్తాను, line లో ఉండండి.
steps.planner_rationale: Since there is no outage, BR_NET_02 requires a line diagnostic before considering a ticket.

steps.purpose: Run diagnostic on the subscriber's line.
Report diagnostic findings to the user.
steps.expected_behavior: Quote the signal strength exactly and state the handset is unsupported, adhering to BR_NET_04.
steps.text: Diagnostic complete అయ్యింది. మీ signal strength -85 dBm ఉంది, కానీ మీ handset network కి support చెయ్యట్లేదు.
steps.planner_rationale: The diagnostic shows the handset is the issue. I must ground the response in the exact numerical signal strength and the handset status.

steps.purpose: Ask for clarification due to low digital literacy.
steps.clean_text: Handset support చెయ్యట్లేదు అంటే ఏంటి? నాకు అర్థం కాలేదు. Plain గా చెప్పండి.
steps.model_visible_text: Handset support చెయ్యట్లేదు అంటే ఏంటి? నాకు అర్థం కాలేదు. Plain గా చెప్పండి.

steps.purpose: Explain the technical finding in plain terms.
steps.expected_behavior: Provide a simple, non-technical explanation of what an unsupported handset means.
steps.text: అంటే మీ phone పాత model అయ్యిండొచ్చు, latest data speeds కి పనిచెయ్యదు. అందుకే data slow గా ఉంది.
steps.planner_rationale: The user struggles with domain terminology. I need to explain that their phone model is likely too old for the current data network.

steps.clean_text: ఓహ్, అంటే network problem లేదు, నా phone problem అంటున్నారా?
steps.model_visible_text: ఓహ్, అంటే network problem లేదు, నా phone problem అంటున్నారా?

steps.expected_behavior: Confirm the user's summary without making forward guarantees about coverage.
steps.text: అవును, network clear గా ఉంది. మీ SIM registered ఉంది కానీ phone support చెయ్యట్లేదు.
steps.planner_rationale: The user correctly summarized the situation. I will confirm this based strictly on the tool outputs.

steps.clean_text: సరే, అర్థం అయ్యింది. నేను వేరే phone చూసుకుంటాను.
steps.clean_span: అర్థం అయ్యింది. నేను వేరే phone చూసుకుంటాను.

ir.terminal_condition: Subscriber informed that their handset is unsupported for the network technology, resolving the slow data complaint without a network ticket.
